stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard agents [-h] {verify,charters} ...

positional arguments:
  {verify,charters}
    verify           Ask the running OpenCode service for its agents and
                     compare each of ours with its expected mode and the rules
                     its definition declares
    charters         Read-only: per live orchestrator, its registry charter
                     and its live session metadata's charter and issue (where
                     a charter number is recorded)

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
